insurer: Royal Sundaram Alliance Insurance Company Limited

room_rent.note: Policy covers inpatient care up to Sum Insured with no explicit room rent sub-limit mentioned in the Product Benefit Table.

icu.note: ICU charges covered under inpatient care up to Sum Insured; no separate ICU sub-limit stated.

copayment.display: None (standard); up to 20% risk co-pay may apply
copayment.note: No mandatory co-payment for standard cases. A risk-based co-payment of up to 20% per condition/overall may be applied at underwriting based on health declarations.

sub_limits.display: Few sub-limits: ambulance ₹4k, AYUSH ₹30k (non-govt), animal bite ₹5k, maternity ₹50k
sub_limits.note: Ambulance capped at ₹4,000; AYUSH capped at ₹30,000 in non-government hospitals; vaccination (animal bite) ₹5,000; maternity ₹50,000; emergency evacuation ₹1,00,000. Core inpatient, day care, organ donor, domiciliary covered up to full SI.

deductible.note: No aggregate deductible on the base plan.

initial_waiting.note: Waived for accidents and on continuous renewal.

ped_waiting.note: 36 months continuous coverage required before PED claims are admissible. No optional reduction add-on mentioned.

specific_disease_waiting.note: 17 named conditions (cataract, hernia, stones, diabetes, arthritis, etc.) have a 24-month waiting period from policy commencement.

maternity.display: Covered (24mo wait, up to ₹50,000, max 2 deliveries)
maternity.note: Inbuilt benefit; 24-month waiting period; limit ₹50,000 per delivery; max 2 deliveries lifetime; newborn cover and vaccination (₹10,000) included; nutrition allowance ₹10,000 post-discharge.

cumulative_bonus.note: 20% of individual base SI added per claim-free policy year; maximum 100% of base SI. Bonus not reduced for future claims once earned.

restoration.note: Re-load of 100% of individual base SI triggered once per policy year after base SI + floater SI + NCB are exhausted. Not available for the same illness/same insured in the same year. Not available for optional benefits.

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses covered for 60 days prior to admission, up to Sum Insured.

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses covered for 90 days after discharge, up to Sum Insured.

day_care.note: Policy explicitly states all day-care procedures are covered; Annexure III provides an illustrative (non-exhaustive) list.

domiciliary.note: Covered if treatment continues for at least 3 uninterrupted days and hospitalisation would otherwise have been required. Pre-hosp payable; post-hosp not payable under this benefit.

ayush.display: Covered (govt hospital up to SI; others up to ₹30,000)
ayush.note: Inpatient AYUSH treatment covered up to full SI in authorised government hospitals; up to ₹30,000 in other hospitals.

organ_donor.note: Inpatient harvesting expenses of organ donor covered. Pre/post-hosp, screening and acquisition costs excluded.

ambulance.note: Road ambulance for emergency transport to nearest adequate hospital.

modern_treatments.note: Policy wording does not explicitly mention modern/robotic/advanced treatments as a named benefit or exclusion beyond standard day-care coverage.

consumables.note: Consumables and non-medical items are excluded per Annexure I (standard IRDAI excluded list). No consumables cover rider mentioned.

global_cover.note: Policy explicitly states territorial scope is India only; all claims settled in Indian rupees.

moratorium.note: After 5 continuous years (60 months) no look-back applied; claims not contestable except for proven fraud.

grace_period.note: 30 days for quarterly, half-yearly and annual premium modes; 15 days for monthly mode.

free_look.note: 30-day free-look from date of receipt of policy. Not applicable for policies with tenure less than 1 year or on renewals.

portability.note: Portability to/from other insurers permitted as per IRDAI guidelines; application required at least 45 days before expiry.

notable_exclusions.display: Psychiatric/mental illness, HIV/AIDS, hereditary conditions (9 named), obesity, sleep disorders, speech disorders, stem cell, reproductive medicine/IVF, sexual problems, OPD treatment

optional_riders.display: Hospital Cash ₹2,000/day (hospitalization beyond 2 days, up to 30 days)
